verdict.rationale: Card issuing is a fair axis for Checkout.com, and the issuing docs cover card programs, cardholder spend controls, and authorization rules. None of the evidence documents cardholder KYC or KYB within issuance: no data requirements, review states, or re-verification flows. Community comments about merchant KYB onboarding documents concern merchant acquiring onboarding, not cardholder verification for issued cards, so they do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, cardholder verification is built into issuance — KYC for consumers and KYB for businesses run through the platform with documented data requirements, review states, and re-verification flows
